ORDER re: 3 Order for Initial Pretrial Conference. Pursuant to the Court's September 1, 2026 Order, ECF No. 3, Defendants were required to file proof of service of the Court's September 1, 2026 Order and the Court's Individual Ru les and Practices in Civil Cases on Plaintiff no later than two days from the date of that Order. To date, Defendants have not filed that proof of service. As a courtesy, that deadline is hereby EXTENDED, nunc pro tunc, to September 11, 2026. Failure to file proof of service by that deadline may result in the case being dismissed as abandoned. SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 9/4/2026) (ar) Order

NOTICE OF INITIAL PRETRIAL CONFERENCE: Unless and until the Court orders otherwise, counsel for all parties shall appear for an initial pretrial conference with the Court on October 20, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. The conference will be held remotely by telephone in accordance with Paragraph 3.B of the Court's Individual Rules and Practices in Civil Cases. The parties should join the conference by calling the Court's dedicated conference line at (855) 244-8681 and using access code 2303 019 3884, followed by the pound (#) key. When prompted for an attendee ID number, press the pound (#) key again. (And as further set forth herein.) SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 9/1/2026) Initial Conference set for 10/20/2026 at 09:00 AM before Judge Jesse M. Furman. (ar) (Entered: 09/01/2026) Order for Initial Pretrial Conference
